scripts.build: npm run clean && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const dirs=['config','controllers','middlewares','models','routes','utils']; fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('app.js',path.join('dist','app.js')); for (const dir of dirs) fs.cpSync(dir,path.join('dist',dir),{recursive:true}); console.log('Build completed: app and backend folders copied to dist');"
